paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset
model_annotation: This chart illustrates a runtime comparison of several models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays model names, specifically "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," arranged in the order presented. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. Two distinct bar groups are present, differentiated by color: a green bar representing "Our Joint Framework" and blue bars representing LLM models. The "Our Joint Framework" bar has a length corresponding to approximately 77 seconds. The series of blue bars representing LLM models includes bars for "ChatGPT" at approximately 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at approximately 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at approximately 172 seconds, and "Claude" at roughly 243 seconds. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color differentiation between the two groups.
